prompt: Sort each part of a run by who decides it.

buckets.label: The harness decides
buckets.hint: Code outside the model that sets the rules.

buckets.label: The model decides
buckets.hint: The next choice the model makes.

items.text: The run stops after a set number of turns
items.why: A turn limit is a rule the harness enforces, whatever the model believes.

items.text: Which word comes next in a reply
items.why: The model scores the next word. The harness only samples from its scores.

items.text: Whether a tool call is allowed to run
items.why: The permission check runs in the harness before the tool does.
That is the model's claim. The harness has to check it before it is accepted.
